message.text:
User is referenced by 7 packages and Memo by 6. I am checking whether api/v1/test counts as a separate package.

I am distinguishing whether test files in the same directory belong to the same package. Proto store types are unlikely to count. IdentityProvider, InstanceSetting, and UserSetting may be referenced as storepb types instead of their direct names. I am also checking whether cmd packages reference store.User.

I am weighing whether to count references that omit the store. prefix. I will also inspect cmd/memos, internal packages, and frontend/rss for direct *User usage. Proto store types are unlikely to count as data-layer entities.

I am refining the search to exclude helper functions such as FindUser. I will also count references to `.User` and `*User` across server packages, and check whether merging test subpackages with their parents changes the tallies.

I will include store/test as an external package because it uses entities. I am also checking proto/store entity messages for cross-package references.

echo "==== cmd ===="
grep -n --include="*.go" 'store\.\(User\|Memo\|Attachment\)' /bench/repo/cmd || true
echo "==== internal ===="
grep -rn --include="*.go" 'store\.\(User\|Memo\|Attachment\|Inbox\|Reaction\)' /bench/repo/internal || true
echo "==== v1/test package ===="
head -5 /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/test/*.go | grep package | sort -u
echo "==== IdentityProvider refs ===="
grep -rn --include="*.go" 'store\.IdentityProvider\|storepb\.IdentityProvider' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=store | head -30
echo "==== InstanceSetting / UserSetting ===="
grep -rn --include="*.go" 'store\.InstanceSetting\|store\.UserSetting' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=store | head -20
echo "==== all store.User files ===="
grep -rl --include="*.go" 'store\.User' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=store
echo "==== all store.Memo files ===="
grep -rl --include="*.go" 'store\.Memo' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=store

message.text:
User is the top persistent entity type by external package references. Memo ranks second. Proto store types may also qualify as persistent entities since they represent serialized forms.

Proto store types are defined in proto files rather than the data layer itself, so they likely do not count as persistent entities. User appears to be referenced by roughly 7 packages, while Memo is referenced by roughly 6. Excluding test packages would yield about 6 and 4 respectively.

Test packages are counted as external references. cmd does not directly reference either entity. The answer is ready.

h11.
1st: User (~7 packages); 2nd: Memo (~6 packages)

Persistent entities are the `store` structs (`Memo`, `User`, `Attachment`, and so on). Counting `store.Type` mentions outside `store/` and `proto/gen`, **User** shows up in seven packages: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`. **Memo** is next with six: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`. Dropping `_test.go` files still ranks User first (~6) then Memo (~4). Attachment is third (~3–4).
